decisions.reason: As a minimum quantity lubrication system that is close to the firm's fluid-handling and machine-tool knowledge base, it fits existing capabilities and can be improved through the firm's own R&D, so despite limited website evidence it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.

A hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's established filtration and coolant expertise, and with strong in-house R&D in a growing industry the firm is well placed to learn from early market feedback and keep it on the market.

A gravity band coolant filter is closely related to the firm's core offer and modular engineering platform, so absorptive capacity is high and the product is likely to stay unless demand proves clearly weaker than expected.
